mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months signals the start of an easing cycle, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in rate hike periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 2% month-over-month signals weak labor demand, reducing consumer spending and compressing discount rates, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising claims periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) below 1.5% month-over-month signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in declining claims periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 over 3 months signals a strengthening supply-side momentum that outpaces demand, pushing discount rates lower and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising production periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 over 3 months signals a softening economy, compressing discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in declining production periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3% signals a supply-side shock that compresses discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in rising inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2% signals a disinflationary environment that lowers discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in declining inflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
